Kudu

Variation 11, round three, grown out of Ply and answering the three complaints against it. The day ring now reads as four kinds without a legend: a tint step per kind and a drawn bead on every arc — a moon over the night, a bowl, a tin and a plate on the meals sized by their calories, a pill and footprints on the moves, a dumbbell on the session. Add opens on the field, with the photo tile large beside it and the mic inside the field, and Send is not drawn until there is something to send. On the plate no label sits on an arc any more: the donut has a legend row under it with a fish, a wheat sheaf and an oil drop, and the target rails — the part that was already right — keep their geometry and gain the same three drawings at 21 px.

Direction

Y0Nkpu0tDvBKSaN2B23sA5Tu

The read
Twenty-four characters again, so it is still a day. What is new is that it is built almost entirely of pairs: two 0s, two 2s, two u's, two N's, two B's, K and k, S and s, T and t. Nothing in the seed says itself once — so nothing on this page does either. Every arc carries a tint and a drawing; every macro carries a colour step and a spot illustration. The digits in order are 0 0 2 2 3 5, and 2, 3 and 5 are three rungs of the system's own Fibonacci space. And K·u·D·u reads straight across the string in order, at characters 4, 6, 9 and 24: the kudu, an animal you tell from every other by the stripes down its flank.
Mood
The day, striped. Know what an arc is before you read a word.
Accent
One indigo, #4c46a6 on the cream and #a49dee on the navy, stepped four ways for the ring — 20 % for sleep, 46 % for meals, 72 % for moves, the accent itself for the workout — and three ways for the plate: protein full, carbs 58 %, fat 30 %. Lime is now on exactly one control in the whole page: the Send that appears once there is something to send. Play has been demoted to ink and the scan line runs indigo, so that stays true.
Drawings
Twelve generated spot illustrations in the palette. On the ring each sits in a cream bead on the arc it names — a moon at the middle of the night, a bowl, a tin and a plate on the three meals, a pill and footprints on the moves, a dumbbell on the session. The legend shows those same drawings. On the plate a fish, a wheat sheaf and an oil drop name the macros in the legend row and again at 21 px on the target rails.
Type
Ply's ladder, untouched: 34 for the number, 11 for the caption, 13 a row title, 21 a screen heading, 15 on a meal name and nowhere else.
Density
The ring's box grew from 288 to 320 so four bands and their beads have room to sit without touching. Everything else keeps Ply's full-bleed bands and its single hairline between them.
Motion
One easing, cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), and 120 / 240 / 480 / 960. Two new ones, both 240 and both a 5 px rise: a bead arrives with the arc it names, and Send arrives with the first character typed.
The idea
A legend is a confession that the chart failed. So the drawing moves onto the mark: the arc that is a meal has a plate on it, and a bigger meal has a bigger plate. The same thought runs the Add sheet — the field is the thing you are doing, the plate tile is the thing beside it, the mic is inside the field where your thumb already is, and the control that writes data does not exist until there is data to write.
01

The day, one ring

Twenty-four hours, four plies, four tints and four drawings. Sleep is the wide pale band on the outside with a moon at the middle of the night; each meal is an arc as long as the meal was large, with its own plate on it — a bowl, a tin, a plate; the moves are short ticks with a pill or a pair of footprints, dimmed while they are still due; the session is the inner bar with a dumbbell. The indigo hand is now. Tap any arc and the card under the ring says what it was; tap a move chip and its arc fills, its bead lights, the count in the middle goes up, today's bar grows and the flame catches when the day closes.

Why a ring and not a list

the reading

A list of eight rows tells you what happened. A ring tells you when, and when is the whole argument: the walk after the largest meal only counts if it followed the largest meal. The gap between the 13:05 arc and the 13:40 arc is the thing the plan is asking for, and on a ring you can see it without reading a word.

02

Add, played

Add opens on the field, with the photo tile large beside it and the mic drawn inside the field on the right. There is no Send: it is not disabled, it is not there. Type one character, tap the tile or tap the mic and the stage swaps in place — and the moment there is something to send, Send arrives in lime, the only lime on the page. Pick an input and press Play and the sheet runs the whole sequence from that same first screen, at the speed the app will run it: text types itself and Send lights; voice draws a waveform and the transcript lands word by word; one photo gets the scan line, then the callouts one at a time, then the meal card rising with the numbers counting up; four photos are read in turn with a tick on each thumbnail. All four end at the same receipt — and at the receipt the meal lands on the ring in section 01 as a new arc with its plate drawn on it, and the calorie number in section 03 moves with it.

03

The plate, as a donut

One donut, three arcs, the day's calories in the middle at 34 px. No label sits on an arc: the names, the grams and the energy are in the legend row under the donut, one line each, with a fish for protein, a wheat sheaf for carbs and an oil drop for fat, and a step of the accent family beside it. The arcs are the energy each macro contributed, not its grams, because the ring has to add to the number in the middle or it is lying; the run against the goal is drawn inside the ring in ink so it never reads as a fourth macro. Under it the target rails are exactly as they were — the fill is as tall as its track and the mark is drawn inside it — with the same three drawings at 21 px on the left.

Why energy and not grams

the donut's rule

Protein and carbohydrate carry 4 kcal a gram, fat carries 9. A donut split by grams would give fat a third of the ring while it supplies half the energy, and the number in the middle would not follow from the arcs around it. So the arcs are kcal and the grams are on the rails underneath, where a target belongs.

04

The expectation, at full width

The hero of Today. Two measured draws, the goal band as a green wash rather than a hatch, the projection dotted to the horizon and the landing number at 34 px right under it. Switch a food rule or a habit and the line re-aims, the band widens or tightens and the number moves — the arithmetic is lib/projection.ts run in the browser: grade-weighted effect × adherence × min(1, horizon ÷ the paper's own duration), summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE. Drag across the plot and the tooltip follows your finger.

What each tile carries

one component

The name and its unit at 11 px, the current value at 34 px, six to twelve readings as a trace with the last one marked in indigo, the optimal band as a dashed green rule across the trace, and the ruler: the band as a green fill inside the track, the value as a 2 px mark inside the same track. The ruler's ends are labelled, so the tile never needs an axis.

Ticking a chip here moves the ring, the bars and the count on the phone above, because they are the same state.

08

Where the numbers come from

Data. The same file as ios-2.html and the other variations: 52 markers with a value, 7 off, TPO 320 IU/mL against normal 0–34, vitamin D 19 ng/mL against 40–60, ferritin 22 ng/mL, LDL 118 mg/dL against the 70–100 goal band, the Aug 1 2026 draw, a 6-day streak with 18 as the best run, three meals on Saturday Sep 5 totalling 1 497 kcal est. and 93 / 93 / 84 g, steps 10 935 against a 90-day mean of 11 062, exercise 43 min against 49, three strength sessions on file for the week. The projection is lib/projection.ts run in the browser on the seeded interventions: effect × grade weight (A and B 1, C 0.5, D and E 0) × adherence × min(1, horizon ÷ the paper's own duration), summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE.ldl_cholesterol = 50, with the band from GRADE_SPREAD. Adherence is the figure on each Plan row: psyllium 86 %, oats 64 %, olive oil 85 %, the walk 57 %, resistance 33 %, plant sterols 71 % if it were adopted. The two dated draws on file are 168 mg/dL on Dec 9 2025 and 131 on Aug 1 2026; 118 is the Sep 1 2026 panel.

The hours. The ring places what is already on file: sleep 23:10 → 06:40 with one break at 03:20, meals at 08:15, 13:05 and 19:30, the selenium at 08:20, the steps total landing at 11:32, the post-meal walk due at 13:40, the resistance session 18:00 → 18:45. Nothing on the ring is invented; it is the same day the list shows, drawn round, and the length of a meal's arc is its own calories.

The drawings. Twelve flat spot illustrations generated in the system's palette with ios-variations/gen-image.sh, looked at one by one, checked at 28 px, scaled to 256 px and inlined into this file as base64 in the same window.IMG map as the photographs. The page is one file: no network asset except the Google Fonts stylesheet.
